message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. The top section contains a red rectangular band and text: "Kocar-kacir Keamanan Penjara H.72" and "Saling Tekan Upah Buruh H.80."

The central image is a large circular graphic resembling a pie chart. A dark maroon border lines the left edge of a large red sector, which takes up more than half the circle. A light blue sector occupies the remaining portion.

At the bottom of the circle, two male figures in white shirts and dark pants are depicted. One figure on the left, with a slender build and short dark hair, leans forward with his hands pressed against the red sector. The figure on the right, with a larger build and short dark hair, leans against the blue sector, reaching his hands toward the red section. Their physical stances suggest they are pushing against the dividing line of the two colored sectors.

Below them, large black text reads "POKOKNYA DUA PUTARAN." Smaller text at the bottom begins with "Presiden Prabowo, Jokowi, dan para anak buahnya bermanuver..." and ends with "H.28." A barcode, date "2-8 DESEMBER 2024," and price "RP 50.000" are in the upper right.
